pages.text_en:
Birch threw a stick high into the air. It flew above the houses of a Minecraft village.
His pet wolf, Byte, ran after the stick. His friend Emmy did not have a pet. But she had a plan to find one.

sentences.text_en: Birch threw a stick high into the air.
sentences.zh: Birch 把一根木棍高高扔向空中。

sentences.text_en: It flew above the houses of a Minecraft village.
sentences.zh: 木棍飞过 Minecraft 村庄的房屋上方。

sentences.text_en: His pet wolf, Byte, ran after the stick.
sentences.zh: 他的宠物狼 Byte 追着木棍跑。

sentences.text_en: His friend Emmy did not have a pet.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友 Emmy 没有宠物。

sentences.text_en: But she had a plan to find one.
sentences.zh: 但她已经想好办法去找一只。

pages.text_en:
"Let's go exploring," said Emmy. "Somewhere in the Overworld, I will find my perfect pet." Birch cheered. Byte wagged his tail. They liked exploring.
The creatures of Minecraft were called mobs. Emmy and Birch knew that some mobs were peaceful and some mobs were hostile.

sentences.text_en: "Let's go exploring," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “我们去探险吧，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "Somewhere in the Overworld, I will find my perfect pet." Birch cheered.
sentences.zh: “在主世界的某个地方，我会找到最适合我的宠物。”Birch 欢呼起来。

sentences.text_en: Byte wagged his tail.
sentences.zh: Byte 摇着尾巴。

sentences.text_en: They liked exploring.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢探险。

sentences.text_en: The creatures of Minecraft were called mobs.
sentences.zh: Minecraft 里的生物被称为生物群体（mobs）。

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch knew that some mobs were peaceful and some mobs were hostile.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 知道，有些生物很温顺，有些生物却具有攻击性。

pages.text_en:
There were many passive mobs in the village. Emmy saw sheep and chickens, a pig and a cow. "These mobs belong to the villagers," Birch said. Emmy agreed, so they went looking elsewhere for a mob to tame.
In a chilly forest called a taiga, they found three rabbits. Emmy thought they were very cute. But she did not want to take a bunny from its family. Byte scared a fox away. GRRRR!

sentences.text_en: There were many passive mobs in the village.
sentences.zh: 村庄里有许多被动型生物。

sentences.text_en: Emmy saw sheep and chickens, a pig and a cow.
sentences.zh: Emmy 看见了羊和鸡，还有一头猪和一头牛。

sentences.text_en: "These mobs belong to the villagers," Birch said.
sentences.zh: “这些生物属于村民，”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: Emmy agreed, so they went looking elsewhere for a mob to tame.
sentences.zh: Emmy 表示同意，于是他们到别处寻找可以驯服的生物。

sentences.text_en: In a chilly forest called a taiga, they found three rabbits.
sentences.zh: 在一片叫作针叶林的寒冷森林里，他们发现了三只兔子。

sentences.text_en: Emmy thought they were very cute.
sentences.zh: Emmy 觉得它们非常可爱。

sentences.text_en: But she did not want to take a bunny from its family.
sentences.zh: 但她不想把小兔子从家人身边带走。

sentences.text_en: Byte scared a fox away.
sentences.zh: Byte 把一只狐狸吓跑了。

pages.text_en:
Birch spotted a bees' nest. What luck! Emmy could keep the bees, and he could collect the honey. "Wait!" cried Emmy.
Birch only wanted to knock the nest out of the tree, but he had forgotten to build a campfire. Now the bees were angry. BUZZZZZZ!

sentences.text_en: Birch spotted a bees' nest.
sentences.zh: Birch 发现了一个蜂巢。

sentences.text_en: What luck!
sentences.zh: 真幸运！

sentences.text_en: Emmy could keep the bees, and he could collect the honey.
sentences.zh: Emmy 可以养这些蜜蜂，而 Birch 可以收集蜂蜜。

sentences.text_en: "Wait!" cried Emmy.
sentences.zh: “等等！”Emmy 喊道。

sentences.text_en: Birch only wanted to knock the nest out of the tree, but he had forgotten to build a campfire.
sentences.zh: Birch 只是想把蜂巢从树上敲下来，却忘了生一堆营火。

sentences.text_en: Now the bees were angry.
sentences.zh: 这下蜜蜂们生气了。

pages.text_en:
The bees chased Emmy, Birch, and Byte out of the woods.
"Bugs do not make good pets,' said Emmy. "No bees, please. And no spiders." "And no silverfish!" said Birch. "Yuck!"

sentences.text_en: The bees chased Emmy, Birch, and Byte out of the woods.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂追着 Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 跑出了树林。

sentences.text_en: "Bugs do not make good pets,' said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “虫子可不是好宠物，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "No bees, please.
sentences.zh: “不要蜜蜂，谢谢。

sentences.text_en: And no spiders." "And no silverfish!" said Birch.
sentences.zh: 也不要蜘蛛。”“也不要蠹虫！”Birch 说。

pages.text_en:
The friends entered a cave. It was a shortcut through the mountain. They saw some bats sleeping high above. But there were other mobs living in the dark—hostile mobs!
Emmy and Birch saw movement in the shadows. A slime bounced. A skeleton rode toward them on a spider's back. A zombie shuffled.

sentences.text_en: The friends entered a cave.
sentences.zh: 朋友们走进了一个洞穴。

sentences.text_en: It was a shortcut through the mountain.
sentences.zh: 这是穿过山脉的一条捷径。

sentences.text_en: They saw some bats sleeping high above.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一些蝙蝠在高处睡觉。

sentences.text_en: But there were other mobs living in the dark—hostile mobs!
sentences.zh: 但黑暗中还住着其他生物——敌对生物！

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch saw movement in the shadows.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 看见阴影在移动。

sentences.text_en: A slime bounced.
sentences.zh: 一只史莱姆弹跳起来。

sentences.text_en: A skeleton rode toward them on a spider's back.
sentences.zh: 一只骷髅骑在蜘蛛背上向他们冲来。

sentences.text_en: A zombie shuffled.
sentences.zh: 一只僵尸蹒跚着走来。

pages.text_en:
Byte leaped at the skeleton, while Birch fought the spider. Emmy used her bow to send arrows flying at the zombie and the slime.
All the noise woke the bats! They fluttered everywhere! There was a light ahead. Emmy and Birch fought their way toward it.

sentences.text_en: Byte leaped at the skeleton, while Birch fought the spider.
sentences.zh: Byte 跳向骷髅，Birch 则和蜘蛛搏斗。

sentences.text_en: Emmy used her bow to send arrows flying at the zombie and the slime.
sentences.zh: Emmy 用弓向僵尸和史莱姆射出一支支箭。

sentences.text_en: All the noise woke the bats!
sentences.zh: 所有的声音把蝙蝠吵醒了！

sentences.text_en: They fluttered everywhere!
sentences.zh: 它们扑扇着翅膀飞得到处都是！

sentences.text_en: There was a light ahead.
sentences.zh: 前方出现了一束光。

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch fought their way toward it.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 一路战斗着向光亮靠近。

pages.text_en:
They made it! Phew! Outside the cavern, the sun was still shining. The friends soon found a jungle full of bamboo, where a baby panda was rolling in the grass.
ACHOO! The baby panda sneezed. A slimeball flew from the panda's nose and almost hit Birch! Maybe a panda was not Emmy's perfect pet.

sentences.text_en: They made it!
sentences.zh: 他们成功了！

sentences.text_en: Outside the cavern, the sun was still shining.
sentences.zh: 走出洞穴时，太阳还在照耀。

sentences.text_en: The friends soon found a jungle full of bamboo, where a baby panda was rolling in the grass.
sentences.zh: 朋友们很快找到了一片竹林，那里有一只小熊猫在草地上打滚。

sentences.text_en: The baby panda sneezed.
sentences.zh: 小熊猫打了个喷嚏。

sentences.text_en: A slimeball flew from the panda's nose and almost hit Birch!
sentences.zh: 一个黏液球从熊猫鼻子里飞出来，差点打中 Birch！

sentences.text_en: Maybe a panda was not Emmy's perfect pet.
sentences.zh: 也许熊猫不是 Emmy 最理想的宠物。

pages.text_en:
They looked in the ocean. Emmy swam with a dolphin, while Birch fought a drowned.
They saw tropical fish, a squid, and a school of pufferfish. Emmy did not have an aquarium. There were no pets for her here.

sentences.text_en: They looked in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 他们又去海边寻找。

sentences.text_en: Emmy swam with a dolphin, while Birch fought a drowned.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和海豚一起游泳，Birch 则和溺尸战斗。

sentences.text_en: They saw tropical fish, a squid, and a school of pufferfish.
sentences.zh: 他们看见热带鱼、鱿鱼，还有一群河豚。

sentences.text_en: Emmy did not have an aquarium.
sentences.zh: Emmy 没有水族箱。

sentences.text_en: There were no pets for her here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有适合她的宠物。

pages.text_en:
Next, they explored the snow and ice. While Birch and Byte fought with a frozen skeleton called a stray, Emmy searched for a pet.
She saw a polar bear cub that was adorable— but the mama bear growled when Emmy got too close! GRRRR! Emmy decided that a polar bear cub would not want to be tamed.

sentences.text_en: Next, they explored the snow and ice.
sentences.zh: 接着，他们探索了冰雪世界。

sentences.text_en: While Birch and Byte fought with a frozen skeleton called a stray, Emmy searched for a pet.
sentences.zh: Birch 和 Byte 与一只叫作流浪者的冰冻骷髅战斗时，Emmy 寻找着宠物。

sentences.text_en: She saw a polar bear cub that was adorable— but the mama bear growled when Emmy got too close!
sentences.zh: 她看见一只可爱得不得了的北极熊幼崽——但 Emmy 靠得太近时，熊妈妈发出了低吼！

sentences.text_en: Emmy decided that a polar bear cub would not want to be tamed.
sentences.zh: Emmy 觉得北极熊幼崽不会愿意被驯服。

pages.text_en:
Finally, after much exploring, they came to a swamp. Byte barked loudly and pointed with his nose. "It's a cat!" said Birch. "Follow it," said Emmy.
But the black cat belonged to a wicked witch. She giggled and threw colorful potions. Emmy, Birch, and Byte ran away as fast as they could. Some potions could be harmful.

sentences.text_en: Finally, after much exploring, they came to a swamp.
sentences.zh: 最后，探险了很久以后，他们来到了一片沼泽。

sentences.text_en: Byte barked loudly and pointed with his nose.
sentences.zh: Byte 大声吠叫，还用鼻子指向前方。

sentences.text_en: "It's a cat!" said Birch.
sentences.zh: “是一只猫！”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: "Follow it," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “跟上它，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: But the black cat belonged to a wicked witch.
sentences.zh: 但那只黑猫属于一个邪恶的女巫。

sentences.text_en: She giggled and threw colorful potions.
sentences.zh: 女巫咯咯笑着，扔出一瓶瓶彩色药水。

sentences.text_en: Emmy, Birch, and Byte ran away as fast as they could.
sentences.zh: Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 尽可能快地逃跑。

sentences.text_en: Some potions could be harmful.
sentences.zh: 有些药水会造成伤害。

pages.text_en:
They ran all the way out of the swamp. They did not hear the HISS of a creeper until it was too late!
OH! The hostile mob exploded!

sentences.text_en: They ran all the way out of the swamp.
sentences.zh: 他们一路跑出了沼泽。

sentences.text_en: They did not hear the HISS of a creeper until it was too late!
sentences.zh: 直到太晚了，他们才听见苦力怕的嘶嘶声！

sentences.text_en: The hostile mob exploded!
sentences.zh: 这个敌对生物爆炸了！

pages.text_en:
The explosion left a hole in the ground, but Emmy, Birch, and Byte were all okay. Emmy was worried. "What if I never find a pet?" Birch told Emmy that she should not give up, and Byte licked her cheek.
Suddenly, they realized there was a horse nearby, standing in the grass of the plains. It was the most beautiful mob Emmy had ever seen.

sentences.text_en: The explosion left a hole in the ground, but Emmy, Birch, and Byte were all okay.
sentences.zh: 爆炸在地面留下一个大洞，但 Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 都没事。

sentences.text_en: Emmy was worried.
sentences.zh: Emmy 忧心忡忡。

sentences.text_en: "What if I never find a pet?" Birch told Emmy that she should not give up, and Byte licked her cheek.
sentences.zh: “如果我永远找不到宠物怎么办？”Birch 告诉 Emmy，她不该放弃；Byte 则舔了舔她的脸颊。

sentences.text_en: Suddenly, they realized there was a horse nearby, standing in the grass of the plains.
sentences.zh: 突然，他们发现附近有一匹马，正站在平原的草地上。

sentences.text_en: It was the most beautiful mob Emmy had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是 Emmy 见过最漂亮的生物。

pages.text_en:
Birch crafted a lead. He made it with string from a spider and the slimeball from the baby panda sneeze. Emmy walked toward the horse. Her movements were slow and quiet.
Emmy took the lead from Birch while he gave the horse an apple. "I will name her Ink," said Emmy. Birch pulled a saddle out of his inventory. "You'll need this." Emmy saddled Ink and climbed on.

sentences.text_en: Birch crafted a lead.
sentences.zh: Birch 制作了一根拴绳。

sentences.text_en: He made it with string from a spider and the slimeball from the baby panda sneeze.
sentences.zh: 他用蜘蛛身上的线和小熊猫打喷嚏时吐出的黏液球做成了拴绳。

sentences.text_en: Emmy walked toward the horse.
sentences.zh: Emmy 慢慢走向那匹马。

sentences.text_en: Her movements were slow and quiet.
sentences.zh: 她的动作又慢又轻。

sentences.text_en: Emmy took the lead from Birch while he gave the horse an apple.
sentences.zh: Birch 给马喂苹果时，Emmy 从他手里接过拴绳。

sentences.text_en: "I will name her Ink," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “我要叫她 Ink，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: Birch pulled a saddle out of his inventory.
sentences.zh: Birch 从物品栏里拿出一副马鞍。

sentences.text_en: "You'll need this." Emmy saddled Ink and climbed on.
sentences.zh: “你会用到这个。”Emmy 给 Ink 装上马鞍，爬了上去。

pages.text_en: Emmy galloped home on Ink's back. Birch and Byte ran alongside them. Their quest into the world of mobs to find a pet had been a success.

sentences.text_en: Emmy galloped home on Ink's back.
sentences.zh: Emmy 骑着 Ink 奔回家。

sentences.text_en: Birch and Byte ran alongside them.
sentences.zh: Birch 和 Byte 在旁边并肩奔跑。

sentences.text_en: Their quest into the world of mobs to find a pet had been a success.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找宠物、探索生物世界的任务成功了。
